setlist.title: Goin' Down The Road Feeling Bad

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Supplication Jam** (2 reviews): Band drops out during the fast Supplication solo; Jerry answers by bringing its guitar licks back during Estimated Prophet's fade-out; Reviewer considers the Supplication jam the genuine highlight of the night [21][25]
- **Eyes Of The World** (2 reviews): After the Supplication tension, the band reunites for a crisp, concise Eyes; Reviewer found the Eyes so intense it nearly caused a heart attack, joking about the cocaine [21][27]
- **Feel Like A Stranger** (1 review): Jerry plays this opener with ferocious energy, tearing through it [19]
- **Peggy-O** (1 review): Peggy-O sounds very clean on the first-set soundboard, with no mistakes [24]
- **Althea** (1 review): Althea also sounds clean and mistake-free on the soundboard [24]

## Setlist highlights

- **Supplication Jam**: back after 293 archived shows (1438 days) [29]

## The recordings

- **gd1980-09-04.sbd.miller.95497.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 22 songs; 157 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [1]. Said about its sound: Charlie Miller's soundboard transfer sounds stellar [25]
- **gd1980-09-04.mtx.seamons.95601.sbeok.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 162 min; rated 3/5 by 3 [2]
- **gd1980-09-04.175071.sbd.miller.phase-repair.flac1644**: soundboard; 22 songs; 157 min [3]
- **gd1980-09-04.nak300.friend.andrewf.104937.flac16**: audience recording; 22 songs; 165 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [4]
- **gd80-09-04.aud.munder.12270.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 22 songs; 156 min; rated 4.5/5 by 4 [9]. Said about its sound: Compared with the other audience tape covering both sets, this one has better quality [17]
- **gd80-09-04.wise.cribbs.24829.sbeok.shnf**: source not stated; 23 songs; 156 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [14]. Said about its sound: Audience tape recorded fairly near the stage; rich, warm, good range; reviewer trimmed the low end, placing it about two-thirds back toward the board; After the drums segment, Phil's bass sits too low in the mix of this audience recording [20][21]
- **gd80-09-04.set1-sbd.17432.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 10 songs; 64 min; rated 4.33/5 by 3 [16]. Said about its sound: The first-set soundboard sounds good, and the audience tape of the whole show is also worthwhile [19]

## Around the show

- The show is overshadowed by the stronger shows surrounding it, but is worth owning [25]
- Reviewer links this show to the September 7 show and the tour's end, with two shows combined [26]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1980-09-04.sbd.miller.95497.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Set 1: SBD -> Master Cassette -> ? -> Dat -> CD; Set 2: SBD -> Master Cassette -> Dat -> CD [1]. Also: Goin' Down The Road came from a Nakamichi 700 master cassette; Althea's end and Looks Like Rain's start fill gaps; pitch correction help from Joe B. Jones [1]
- **gd1980-09-04.mtx.seamons.95601.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Hunter Seamons; source: Matrix mix (SBD/AUD) [2]. Also: Matrix: set 1 soundboard via master cassette to DAT and CD, set 2 likewise; all transfers and mastering by Charlie Miller [2]
- **gd1980-09-04.175071.sbd.miller.phase-repair.flac1644**: transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  November 6, 2025; source: Set 1: SBD > Cassette Master > ? > DAT > CD Set 2: SBD > Cassette Master > DAT > CD [3]. Also: This version repairs the vocal phase problem on the earlier Miller soundboard release, with pitch-correction help from Joe B. Jones [3]
- **gd1980-09-04.nak300.friend.andrewf.104937.flac16**: taped by Tim Friend; transferred by Andrew F.; source: FOB AUD: 2x Nakamichi CM300/CP1 cardioids > Nakamichi 550 > Maxell XLII 90's, mics on stand, set up FOB aprx 20th row, center right. Taped by Tim Friend. [4]
- **gd80-09-04.aud.munder.12270.sbeok.shnf**: source: AUD>MC>DAT>SF>CD [9]
- **gd80-09-04.wise.cribbs.24829.sbeok.shnf**: source: FOB Sony ECM-280s mounted on a stand > Sony TC-D5 > MAC > playback on Nakamichi Dragon (Dolby B decoded) > Sony PCM R-700 (A>D passthrough) > Zefiro ZA2 > WAV… [14]
- **gd80-09-04.set1-sbd.17432.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [16]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Providence Civic Center - September 4, 1980](https://www.dead.net/show/september-4-1980) [30]
